messages.subject: Automated function parameter insert with Content Assist
messages.subject_clean: Automated function parameter insert with Content Assist
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

Is there any to autocompele function definition and insert parameters names?

Say I have following function:

 >     GetFC = function(key_, portf_name_, type_, db_name_){}

Then when I use content assist I see following picture:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/89498/wikiPictures/autoComplete.png


Is there anyway, that content assist will insert not only the function 
name, but also all parameters?
Like that:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/89498/wikiPictures/resultAutoComplete.png


Regards
Cron Acronis

messages.body_plain:
Hi Cron,

sorry, this is not possible at the moment.

(After the insertion of the function name, the parameters are shown in 
the small info box and you can insert a single parameter name by 
invoking the content assist again.)

Why you want to do that, code convention?

Regards,
Stephan

messages.subject: Re: statet can not find cygwin R
messages.subject_clean: statet can not find cygwin R
messages.body_plain:
Hi Foehn,

[2015-04-26 13:14] foehn wrote:
> Dear StatET users,
>
> Previously I used R (v3.1.2) for Windows (binary package from R-project)
> and StatET (v3.4.1) for Eclipse (v4.4.0), they worked without issue. But
> when I changed to the cygwin version (v2.870) of R (v3.1.3, installed
> directly from pre-built cygwin packages), StatET can not recognize the R
> installation. Is it because StatET does not support the cygwin version
> of R? Could anyone give any hints? Thanks in advance.

The cygwin version of R is not specifically supported.

Regards,
Stephan
